# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Path and readback corrections**

## Highlights

The next m156 update corrects clipped path rasterization, glyph replay and Graphite pixel readback. These native servicing changes leave managed APIs and package versions unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Clipped convex paths** — Corrects anti-aliased convex path rasterization across vertical clip gaps, bounds additive-blitter runs and uses saturating fixed-point arithmetic for far-offscreen edges. ([#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
- **Glyph replay and GPU clipping** — Validates serialized Slug data and direct-mask replay, preserves creation-time rounding, and retains fallbacks for unsuitable glyphs. Also corrects Ganesh path bounds and coverage-mask clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge bounds. ([#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624), [#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617))
- **Complete Graphite RGBx readback** — Corrects pixel-size and row-stride handling when transferring an alpha texture to an RGBx destination, ensuring every destination pixel bit is written. ([#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
